Home Effect Types Fuzz P19 P19 Smooth soaring sustain Specifically tuned to the sound of a block-buster 1979 album (okay, it's "The Wall") and emulates the "magic" 70's era fuzz pedal Unlike typical muffs, this era was clear and articulate on high notes while still fuzzy and aggressive on low notes, without excessive low-end muffiness or high-end fizz. The mids are scooped just enough to keep it from sounding congested, the lows are rolled off just enough to keep it from sounding wooly or boomy, and the highs are gentle, present, and well balanced. read more reviews clips SKU: P19-deposit MPN: SKR-P19 Stock Status: Preorder Delivery Status: Lead time of about 2 weeks We build everything to order. Our current wait time is approximately 2 weeks to 1 month. I will confirm your order shortly, and I will send you a PayPal invoice for the total amount due including shipping when your order is ready. --Marc Price: $259 + shipping $259 $233.10 (10% off) 50% deposit $116.55 Quantity qty Add To Cart Smooth soaring sustain Reviews • Clips • Manual Its clarity will encourage you to dig in and express yourself; it's not an overwhelming "wall of fuzz" type effect. A wide variety of aggressive and clear-sounding applications, particularly excelling in sustaining, biting, legato lead work High Gain, Low-Noise, and Dialed In You can have a flat setting with a subtle, barely-there scoop or "pinch" to the mids Or you can flick the switch to hump for more juiciness, fullness, and fatness. Reviews Mustafa Can Kaya Bjorn at Gilmourish.com Read full archived review on wayback Kit Rae Review of the Skreddy P19 Gavin "Hi marc. I've recieved my p19. Thank you very much.i plugged it in and wow I didn't even have to touch the knobs or tweak the sound. It was perfect out of the box.you sir are a genius. I now have that elusive wall tone I've been chasing my whole Life." Mark "Hi there, just got a P19 from you yesterday and it's everything I hoped for and more. There's some real magic in there with the sustain on low and the tone on high -- it's not just usable, it's special. Fingered dyads are buttery with some sizzle. The pedal is perfect and looks incredible." Ryan "FYI, this is my second Skreddy pedal. I have a Lunar Module Mini Deluxe as well. They are the only dirt pedals on my board right now and I couldn't be happier. They sound equally great with my strat, tele and SG. Before the P19, I was using a xxxx with a compressor in front and overdrive after. The P19 sounds similar to that entire chain all by itself, but the tone control and flat/hump switch give it a lot wider range of sounds. The P19 is definitely the tightest, most usable Muff I've ever heard!" dap9 "P19 came in today. Immediately threw my modded xxx muff clone off the board – and I really like that pedal! I'm no Muff expert, but damn this thing is nice. Unlike my xxx and other Muffs I’ve played, the P19 is much crisper and defined (so it’s not desirable if you want that big woofy sound). I had modded the xxx clone so it had a Mids Boost switch that I had to have on in a band setting. The P19’s Flat setting is more mids focused (in a good way) than my Mids Boosted xxx so I’m sure it’s going to sing in a band setting. Skreddy Pedals browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive fuzz browse by enclosure pedal Skreddy Pedals P19 Published on January 27, 2012 Skreddy Pedals fuzz pedal Information The Skreddy Pedals P19 is a fuzz pedal inspired by the iconic guitar tones of Pink Floyd's 1979 album The Wall . Based on a modified Big Muff circuit, it was designed to deliver smooth, soaring sustain with exceptional clarity and articulation, avoiding the muddiness and excessive fizz often associated with high-gain fuzz designs. The P19 balances its EQ response by slightly scooping the mids to prevent congestion, rolling off low frequencies to reduce boominess, and shaping the highs to remain present without harshness. This tuning makes it particularly well-suited for sustaining lead tones that cut through a mix while retaining a creamy, musical quality. A key feature of the pedal is its mid-voicing switch, which provides two tonal options: a flat setting with a subtle scoop for clarity, or a hump setting that boosts midrange frequencies for added thickness, juiciness, and presence. This versatility allows the P19 to shift between articulate solo tones and fuller, more saturated sounds. Designed as a high-gain but low-noise fuzz, the P19 excels at sustaining, biting, legato lead work while still offering enough dynamic response to remain expressive. Controls Volume : Adjusts the overall output level Sustain : Controls the amount of fuzz and sustain Tone : Shapes the EQ balance between bass and treble Flat/Hump Switch : Selects between a subtle mid scoop (flat) and a boosted midrange (hump) Technical Specifications Circuit: Big Muff-style fuzz with modified EQ Power: Standard 9V DC power supply; confirmed to operate up to 18V for increased headroom Construction: Aluminum enclosure Dimensions: approx. 3" wide x 5" deep x 1" tall Highlights Designed to capture the sustaining lead tones of Pink Floyd's The Wall Big Muff-based fuzz tuned for clarity and articulation Balanced EQ with controlled lows, scooped mids, and smooth highs Mid-voicing switch for flat or boosted midrange response High gain, low noise design optimized for expressive lead work Video Date ▼▲ Maker ▼▲ Video ▼▲ Time ▼▲ 2013-12-17 BjornRiis Skreddy Pedals P19 review 4:00 2012-06-12 Burgerman666 Skreddy Pedals: P19 - Strat to HIWATT UK Custom 50 6:11 2012-05-26 elswan64
